findings.note: 'шаблон' is a new product term for 'starter', recorded in neither i18n/glossary.md nor the ru style guide; ui.agents.starters paraphrases the concept as 'встроенный агент'. The choice is defensible (sidecar defines starter as a packaged template agent; 'встроенного' ties it to the built-in family; 'стартового' would collide with 'стартовая страница'/'стартовый грант'), so the string stays. Suggest recording a ru locale call: starter -> 'встроенный шаблон'. No string change needed.

'вместе' is slightly redundant; 'Поставляется с приложением' or 'Входит в состав приложения' are marginally tighter. Keep the current text for verbatim consistency with ui.agents.detail.alert.builtin_body.

scope: WHOLE-NAMESPACE LINGUISTIC AUDIT of the three keys of ui.agents.detail.origin (shipped_with_app, installed_starter, compare_packaged): mechanical (key set equals English, valid JSON, no placeholders/plurals/markup, no bidi/zero-width/NBSP characters), accuracy, register, terminology against ru/ui.agents.starters and ru/ui.agents.detail, gender agreement ('Установлен' agrees with 'агент'), form (two sentences end with a full stop, the label does not). This is NOT a rendered-layout audit: no rendered frame, wrapping or live UI was inspected. I did not run the repo validators for the audit itself.
verified: Starter question: ru/ui.agents.starters has no word for 'starter' (it says 'встроенных агентов'); 'шаблон' appears nowhere else in the ru catalogue; the choice contradicts no existing word and does not read as a sample, a server or another agent.

'Packaged' is rendered consistently: origin.changed 'встроенной копии', compare_packaged 'встроенными инструкциями', alert.builtin_title 'Встроенный агент'; shipped_with_app reuses alert.builtin_body's 'поставляется вместе с приложением'.
shipped_with_app (present tense, part of the app) and installed_starter (completed action, installed copy) stay distinguishable; parallel to created_locally 'Создан на этом компьютере.'
